headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals took down the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 3-2 victory, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the offense with a strong performance. The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks behind CJ Abrams' 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, with Robbie Ray earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Athletics catcher Shea Langeliers has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a torn meniscus in his right knee. Other notable injuries include Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins, left oblique strain), Josh Jung (Texas Rangers, left calf strain), and Juan Soto (New York Mets, left calf strain).

The Boston Red Sox made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead. The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash, while the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres for Future Considerations.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals edged out the Detroit Tigers in a close game, securing a 3-2 win. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Angels 9-2**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 9-2 behind a strong performance from Robbie Ray, who earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease, who pitched 9.0 innings with 12 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Shea Langeliers on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics catcher Shea Langeliers has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a torn meniscus in his right knee, retroactive to July 25, 2026.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
